name: Fulgurhorn
biography: Monocero funiculus. A storm-charged unicorn-beast whose horn is a living lightning rod — shocking it only reloads its Fulgurshot. Habitat: Coast & Desert.

features.name: Charged Aura
features.description: While the fulgurhorn's Fulgurshot action is charged, the fulgurhorn emits an aura of electrostatic energy in a 10-foot Emanation. Whenever a creature within the Emanation hits the fulgurhorn with a weapon made of metal, the creature takes 6 (1d12) Lightning damage.

features.name: Lightning Rod
features.description: Whenever the fulgurhorn is subjected to Lightning damage, it recharges its Fulgurshot action.

features.name: Multiattack
features.description: The fulgurhorn makes one Horn attack and one Tail attack.

features.name: Horn
features.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (1d12 + 4) Piercing damage. If the fulgurhorn moved 20+ feet straight toward the target immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 9 (2d8) Lightning damage.

features.name: Tail
features.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7, reach 10 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Slashing damage, and the target is knocked Prone.

features.name: Fulgurshot (Recharge 6; See Lightning Rod Trait)
features.description: Saving Throw: DC 14 Dexterity, each creature in a 60-foot-long, 5-foot-wide Line. Failure: 18 (4d8) Lightning damage. Success: Half damage.

features.name: Call Lightning
features.description: A point of the fulgurhorn's choice on the ground within 60 feet of it blazes with sapphire, electrostatic energy. At the start of the fulgurhorn's next turn, a bolt of lightning strikes in a 5-foot-radius, 300-foot-high Cylinder centred on that point. Each creature in the area takes 11 (2d10) Lightning damage.
